name: Amit Gupta
player_statement:
A complete player, Amit Gupta has made a big mark in cricket. With 18 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 44*, with an average of 10.29 and a quick strike rate of 95.36. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 11 sixes and 3 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 20.5 overs, taking 12 wickets at an economy rate of 6.91. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
